## Triage: first grade, `priority:p2` · `pm:queue` · triage seat · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-16T23:00Z

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015). ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

- **Why p2:** at 1024 px the Approve / Reject column sits past the card edge, so an approver must scroll sideways to act.
- **For the claimant:** The filer's `domain:ui` and `area:workflow` stand. Pin the action column and truncate or wrap the record title.

Claim: PM loop round 3 (`priority:p2` bug; filed by this seat from objectui#12708's report, graded by the triage seat, `6226284762`)

File surface: `apps/console/src/pages/system/ApprovalsInboxPage.tsx` (the inbox table: the Approve / Reject column pinned right, the Record column bounded so a long title truncates), its tests beside it under `apps/console/src/pages/system/`, one `.changeset/12816-*.md`. ⛔ `packages/components/src/ui/**` stays out of bounds; the shared overflow box from objectui#12708 (`packages/components/src/custom/`) is used as published, not changed. Stop on breach; explain in the report.
Container & model: `M`, `mode:cloud`, `model: opus` (cloud on the maintainer's stance 「可以的话，ui 后续开发尽量用云 session，并且要求截图给我看」; lane scope on 「你也可以接ui车道的卡」; batch 3 on 「当前任务处理完，后续并发降到3」, this session's chat, 2026-10-16)

Serial constraints cleared: objectui#12708 (the same table's overflow box) landed as `4839f5c`. No open objectui PR touches `ApprovalsInboxPage.tsx` (read at dispatch).
